call-to-missing-route.message: NotesClient.archive sends POST /notes/:param/archive to orders, which serves no such route
call-to-missing-route.evidence: every route of the service it is sent to was read: no address left partly unread, no catch-all
call-to-missing-route.fix: the nearest route: POST /notes/:param/export (one segment off: archive for export)

unguarded-among-guarded.message: DELETE /claims/:param has no guard in front of it, while the 2 other writes of ClaimsController have StaffGuard in front.
unguarded-among-guarded.evidence: every other write of its router is guarded and the routes of src/claims/claims.controller.ts were read whole; no public marker is on it

unguarded-among-guarded.message: DELETE /pickups/:param has no guard in front of it, because StaffGuard (skipped by @SkipStaffCheck), while the 2 other writes of PickupsController have StaffGuard in front.

config-not-set.message: CACHE_HOST is read with no default, and none of ledger's deployment files sets it (docker-compose.yml)
config-not-set.evidence: every deployment file of the service was read for the names it sets; a value given outside the files (a secret store, a console, the shell) is what would make this wrong
config-not-set.fix: set CACHE_HOST where ledger is deployed, or give the read a default

config-not-set.message: LEDGER_REGION is read with no default, and none of ledger's deployment files sets it (docker-compose.yml); LEDGER_ZONE, set in docker-compose.yml and read nowhere, is likely the same setting renamed
config-not-set.evidence: every deployment file of the service was read for the names it sets; a value given outside the files (a secret store, a console, the shell) is what would make this wrong
config-not-set.fix: one setting renamed on one side: read LEDGER_ZONE, or set LEDGER_REGION where LEDGER_ZONE is set
